command:
from pathlib import Path
text = Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
start = text.index('name: Retornatus gates')
rest = text[start:]
job = rest[: rest.index('\n  lowest-direct:')]
assert 'permissions:' in job
assert 'contents: read' in job
assert 'pull-requests: write' in job
assert 'uses: ./' in job
writes = [line.strip() for line in job.splitlines() if line.strip().endswith(': write')]
assert writes == ['pull-requests: write'], writes
print('ok')
